name: prism
description: PRISM codewatch in Claude Code: the harness loop (gitleaks and a PRISM review before Claude runs git push, and optionally before it finishes), the prism-cli MCP tools, /prism slash commands and a SessionStart summary of this branch's open findings. Needs prism-cli 1.11.0 or later on PATH for the harness loop and /prism:review (1.10.0 for the rest).

finish_gate.title: Review before Claude finishes
finish_gate.description: Run the PRISM review when Claude stops and keep it working on blocking findings (at most 2 rounds). Costs one reviewer call per finish.

push_gate.title: Review before Claude pushes
push_gate.description: Run gitleaks and the PRISM review before Claude runs git push. Secrets block the push either way.
